# Second-batch ABC references

Read on 2026-10-23 from https://trillian.mit.edu/~jc/music/book/EverydaySongBook/ using the exact filenames in this directory. The Everyday Song Book (1927), John Chambers transcriptions (2015/2017). Lyrics and prose comments are excluded; music tokens, barlines and attribution headers are preserved.

Only letter-prefixed `X:`-style lines are metadata; a `|:` repeat start is music and must not be removed. Full bar counts and independent note/duration comparisons are enforced by `../../stage7Batch2.test.ts`.

The other two songs in this batch use visually checked numbered-notation pages rather than ABC. Their source URLs, page numbers, voice selection and adaptation boundaries are in `../../../docs/sources/stage-7-library.md`.
